_why: Human decisions that must survive re-extraction. The same idea as the
CORRECTIONS block in scripts/extract-charts.mjs: a judgement made once, by
someone who read the books, should not have to be made again every time the
model is re-run. add-series applies this file after extraction.
Anything here is a claim about canon, so each entry says why.

dropCharacters.why: Lupo Proelia is the rebellion, not a person. dropNonPeople cannot catch it: the model listed the faction under the id `rebellion` and separately emitted `lupo_proelia` as a character, so neither the id nor the label matches anything in the factions list. A human knows they are the same group.

mergeCharacters.role: Smuggler and gambler out of Zilvaren; revealed as heir to the Yvelian throne
mergeCharacters.why: One person, not two. The extractor emitted both names and joined them with a `family` edge labelled 'identity' — it spotted the reveal and had no field to put it in. The reveal happens inside book 1, so there is no reading position at which he is only a smuggler, which is why this is a merge and not a `perceived` entry.

retypeRelationships.label: Former king and queen of Yvelia
retypeRelationships.why: Extracted as `family` labelled 'former_royal_pair'. They were married, and `family` is for kinship.

addRelationships.label: Open hostility → reluctant alliance. Slow burn.
addRelationships.why: The verifier rejected this, reasoning that the notes say they 'move to a reluctant alliance' without stating outright that they are allies. Overruled by a reader: moving to an alliance is arriving at one.

addRelationships.label: A rogue from her past in Zilvaren, pulled through the portal with her.
addRelationships.why: Carrion had no edges at all despite being a main character. A recall miss, not a judgement call.

addFactions.label: Yvelian Court
addFactions.why: Belikon rules Yvelia from the Winter Palace, per the notes, and Orious is his right hand. Listed as a faction in the Fantasy Fangirls guide used for the research.

addFactions.label: Cahlish
addFactions.why: Cahlish is a fiefdom warded against Belikon — the notes make it a separate allegiance from his court, not a place within it.

addFactions.label: Zilvaren
addFactions.why: Madra rules Zilvaren as an immortal queen. The mortal city is its own power, not part of either Fae side.

Base record is her book-1 state — the Blood Court crown is book 2. Stated in pipeline/input/fae-and-alchemy.md, which is sourced. The pipeline only infers a place when exactly one is named in the lines mentioning a character, so anyone described across two realms stayed Unplaced.
